Callout.Name: Chest Pain
Callout.Message: Person with chest pain, history of heart problems.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, pale, sitting on a bench.
Callout.Patient: It is easing. It does not feel like the last one, but it does not feel right.

Lines.Approach: Pale, sweating, and he has a history. Do not let him walk anywhere.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
